records.title: FORM 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2023
records.text: Consolidated net sales in 2023 totaled $1,243.6 million, a 13.9% increase as compared to consolidated net sales of $1,092.2 million in 2022.

records.title: FORM 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2023
records.text: Our operating performance throughout 2023 has benefited from fewer supply chain disruptions enabling us to obtain key component parts, increase production and reduce backlog.

records.title: FORM 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2023
records.text: Our strong organic sales increase was mainly supported by our ability to reduce backlog through the procurement of key component parts to facilitate increased production output.

records.title: FORM 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2023
records.text: •Organic sales increase of approximately 13.6% primarily due to the impact of higher selling prices across all regions and volume increases; and

records.title: FORM 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2023
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities in 2023 was $188.4 million compared to net cash provided by operating activities of $25.1 million in 2022.
